headline: NPPA caps trade margins on 137 cancer medications
hook: New price caps on 137 cancer drugs
summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) has capped trade margins for 137 cancer drugs at 30% to reduce out-of-pocket expenses for patients. This move aims to curb excessive markups by hospitals and pharmacies in the supply chain. While the order targets trade margins, the actual reduction in final patient bills remains uncertain due to potential price adjustments by manufacturers. This policy directly impacts the revenue models of hospital chains and pharmacy retailers.

winners_losers: Cancer patients gain / Hospital pharmacies hurt
